svg.title: The Vahtian tool family
svg.desc: Three stages — start by checking your own manuscript with CiteVahti; prepare the study with StudyVahti, MethodVahti, DictVahti and MatchVahti-Lite; scale to systematic-review infrastructure with ReviewVahti, ExtractVahti, GuidelineVahti and AtlasVahti — all standing on one evidence record: human rates first, blinded AI second, adjudicated, hash-chained, provenance or flag.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: RESEARCH CITATION INTEGRITY · LOCAL-FIRST TOOL FAMILY
